i.norm: Tests that building an {@link UnsynchronizedByteArrayInputStream} with a negative length is rejected.

Builds a stream from the given byte array, offset and length.

The builder's {@code get()} declares a checked {@link IOException}, but it can never be thrown here because the origin is already a {@code byte[]} (no conversion happens), so any such exception is reported as an unexpected test failure.
A negative length must be rejected with an {@link IllegalArgumentException}.
